An urgent warning ends with mercy and confidence in God's keeping power

Most of the letter condemns the people who crept in (verses 4–16). Verses 20–21 turn to the readers’ own faith, prayer, and waiting. Verse 22 then turns to how the readers treat others. It asks for compassion and for “making a distinction.” Not everyone is treated the same way. Verse 23 names a second group to be saved with fear, snatched from the fire. Verse 24 says who finally keeps anyone from stumbling: God.
